formulas.tex: \term{hand}{\mathrm{HAND}}(c) = \term{cellElevation}{z_c} - \term{drainageElevation}{z_{d(c)}},\quad \term{drainage}{d}(c) = \text{first stream cell on the D8 path from } c
formulas.ascii: HAND(c) = z(c) - z(d(c)); d(c) = first stream cell on the D8 path from c (c itself on a stream cell), found by pointer jumping p = p[p]; 0 on stream cells; NaN when the path ends without a stream, meets an unresolved word, or the elevations are not finite
